A Date for Mad Mary.title: A Date for Mad Mary
A Date for Mad Mary.overview_en: "Mad" Mary McArdle returns to Drogheda after a short spell in prison for something she'd rather forget. Back home, everything and everyone has changed. Her best friend, Charlene, is about to get married and Mary is maid of honor. When Charlene refuses Mary a 'plus one' on the grounds that she probably couldn't find a date, Mary becomes determined to prove her wrong.

A Fantastic Woman.title: A Fantastic Woman
A Fantastic Woman.overview_en: Marina's life is thrown into turmoil following the death of her partner. Mourning the loss of the man she loved, she finds herself under intense scrutiny from those with no regard for her privacy.

alternative_titles.title: Eine Fantastische Frau - Una Mujer Fantástica

A Fantastic Woman.tagline: My name is Marina Vidal. Do you have any problem with that?

A Girl at My Door.title: A Girl at My Door
A Girl at My Door.overview_en: Sent from Seoul to serve in a remote coastal village, a policewoman gets involved in the life of a mysterious teenage girl who is abused by both her father and her grandmother.
A Girl at My Door.tagline: I'll do my best. I'll do anything.

A Marine Story.title: A Marine Story
A Marine Story.overview_en: Marine officer Alexandra is tough enough to kick any guy's ass in a bar fight, but there's one opponent she can't beat: military policy. When she returns to her conservative hometown from Iraq with a mysterious personal life, she finds herself charged with preparing a tempestuous teenage girl to boot camp.

A Perfect Ending.title: A Perfect Ending
A Perfect Ending.overview_en: This intimate drama follows Rebecca, a woman who has kept her sexuality a secret from her friends but chooses to reveal it to a stranger. While Rebecca's revelations may not yield the results she expects, a perfect ending is still in reach.
A Perfect Ending.tagline: It’s not always what you expect…

Aimee & Jaguar.title: Aimée & Jaguar
Aimee & Jaguar.overview_en: In 1943, while the Allies are bombing Berlin and the Gestapo is purging the capital of Jews, a dangerous love affair blossoms between two women – one a Jewish member of the underground, the other an exemplar of Nazi motherhood.
Aimee & Jaguar.tagline: Bound By Desire. Torn Apart By War.

Alena.title: Alena
Alena.overview_en: When Alena arrives at her new elite boarding school, Filippa and the other girls start to harass her. But Alena’s best friend Josefin won’t let her take anymore beating. If she won’t strike back, Josefin will do it for her. Hard.

Alice Júnior.title: Alice Júnior
Alice Júnior.overview_en: This is the story of Alice Junior, a transgender girl full of life, who wants to give her first kiss, but first, she just wants to be who she really is.

All About E.title: All About E
All About E.overview_en: A beautiful sexy DJ is forced to run when she stumbles on a stash of cash. Can she keep the money, conquer her demons, AND get the girl?

All Over Me.title: All Over Me
All Over Me.overview_en: Claude and Ellen are best friends who live in a not-so-nice area of New York. They're involved in the subculture of 90s youth, complete with drugs, live music, and homophobia. All is changed one night when a violent and meaningless death rocks their lives.
All Over Me.tagline: In a world that expects you to fit in, sometimes you have to stand out.

Almost Adults.title: Almost Adults
Almost Adults.overview_en: A film about growing apart when growing up. Two best friends relationship strains when one deals with her newfound sexuality and the other with breaking up with her long term boyfriend.
Almost Adults.tagline: Growing up is hard when you're growing apart.

Ammonite.title: Ammonite
Ammonite.overview_en: In 1840s England, palaeontologist Mary Anning and a young woman sent by her husband to convalesce by the sea develop an intense relationship. Despite the chasm between their social spheres and personalities, Mary and Charlotte discover they can each offer what the other has been searching for: the realisation that they are not alone. It is the beginning of a passionate and all-consuming love affair that will defy all social bounds and alter the course of both lives irrevocably.

alternative_titles.title: Ammonite ฝังรักเราไว้...ในกาลเวลา

Anaïs in Love.title: Anaïs in Love
Anaïs in Love.overview_en: A young woman struggling to stay on top of everything in her life meets a married publisher and begins an affair with him.

Anatomy of a Love Seen.title: Anatomy of a Love Seen
Anatomy of a Love Seen.overview_en: A film within a film that explores love in all its painful and messy glory.  Six months ago Zoe and Mal fell for each other while filming a love scene, which led to an intense, whirlwind affair, followed by a devastating breakup. Soon after their split, things get complicated when the two have to meet on set once more to re-shoot that fateful sequence.

And Then Came Lola.title: And Then Came Lola
And Then Came Lola.overview_en: A talented, but distracted photographer, Lola, on the verge of success in both love and work, could lose it all if she doesn't make it to a crucial meeting on time. But, as usual, Lola is late. With her job and girlfriend on the line, she has three chances to make it right. In a desperate race through the streets and back rooms of San Francisco, time grows short-will Lola make it? Will she come at all? With a pop sensibility that mixes live action, animation and still photography, And Then Came Lola explores love's age old question in a fresh new way, "If you try, try again, will you finally get it right?" (Written by M. Siler and E. Seidler)

Anne+.title: Anne+: The Film
Anne+.overview_en: Just before Anne is moving from Amsterdam to live with her great love Sara in Montreal, her publisher criticizes the manuscript for her first novel. What exactly is the story she's trying to tell? Does she even have something to say at all? Anne is forced to search for what she wants in life, because it is not only the main character in her novel who seems to be a little lost.

Appropriate Behavior.title: Appropriate Behavior
Appropriate Behavior.overview_en: Shirin is struggling to become an ideal Persian daughter, politically correct bisexual and hip young Brooklynite but fails miserably in her attempt at all identities.
Appropriate Behavior.tagline: Being without a cliché to hold onto can be a lonely experience.

AWOL.title: AWOL
AWOL.overview_en: A young soldier unexpectedly returns to his rural family home, forcing a reunion overshadowed by grief and secrets.
